# Get Out Now

> NOTE: This site is currently a placeholder (the repository contains only a
> README). This llms.txt describes the intended mission so AI crawlers and the
> sibling sites have context; it will be expanded once site content is added.

> Get Out Now is intended as a diaspora-relocation resource focused on the
> Israeli Law of Return and the practical logistics of relocating ("making
> Aliyah"), aimed at Jews and those with Jewish ancestry who are considering or
> planning a move.

## About (intended)

- Focus: eligibility under the Law of Return (including the 1970 "grandchild clause"), and the practical logistics of diaspora relocation / evacuation.
- Status: placeholder — no live content or forms yet.

## Related initiatives

Get Out Now is one of six independent sibling nonprofit sites:

- [interfaith-sanctuary.org](https://interfaith-sanctuary.org/) — a non-denominational interfaith sanctuary.
- [thelastdate.org](https://thelastdate.org/) — nonprofit matchmaking initiative.
- [projectshreeram.org](https://projectshreeram.org/) — Hindu–Jewish and India–Israel relations.
- [1in56million.org](https://1in56million.org/) — British-Israelite / genealogy research.
- [crypto-jews.org](https://crypto-jews.org/) — Anusim / Converso community and Sephardic genealogy.
